$comment: Dead internal link targets, read off the EMITTED Next.js route inventory (.next/app-path-routes-manifest.json) by scripts/link-integrity-check.js, never off the app/ directory tree. Regenerate deliberately with `node scripts/link-integrity-check.js --update`; the diff is meant to be reviewed. A dynamic capture can never appear here — it is always a failure and --update refuses to record one.
$doc: Dead internal link targets tolerated until their owning finding is closed.
This list may only ever SHRINK.
Every entry carries the finding id that owns the fix, so nothing here is "silenced" — it is queued.
An entry whose target resolves again, or that nothing links to any more, is a FAILURE: remove it.

"class": "prefix-constant" marks a target referenced ONLY as a string prefix that nothing will ever create; it stops counting as dead DEBT but still carries a reason and an owning finding, and the gate REFUSES the class by file:line if any reference to it sits on an href-like line.
"deadShapes" is the same ceiling for interpolated hrefs that could not be resolved to concrete targets, keyed on the shape (/admin/guardians/*) and held to the same four rules.

/admin/accept-invite.reason: middleware.ts AUTH_ROUTES_BY_PORTAL exemption for a route that does not exist. Not a navigation link; an invitation email lands on a 404 and the exemption list makes it look handled. Owner: V3-E05.

/api/auth.reason: middleware.ts:34 PUBLIC_PREFIXES entry — the NextAuth namespace root, consumed by startsWith and never navigated to. /api/auth/[...nextauth] is a catch-all needing at least one segment, so the bare namespace cannot resolve BY CONSTRUCTION: there is no route anyone could ever add here, hence nothing to queue. Classified prefix-constant (S-E06-5 / PF-93) so it stops counting as dead debt; the class is REFUSED with a file:line the moment any reference to it sits on an href-like line, so it cannot become a quieter baseline. Owner: none — closed as a false positive, kept for provenance.

/favicon.reason: middleware.ts:34 PUBLIC_PREFIXES entry — an asset prefix for /favicon.ico, consumed by startsWith. Not a route, and no route will ever be created at it: assets are served from public/, not from the router. Classified prefix-constant (S-E06-5 / PF-93) rather than counted as dead debt, under the same refusal rule as /api/auth. Owner: none — closed as a false positive, kept for provenance.

/legal.reason: middleware.ts:35 PUBLIC_PREFIXES entry — the legal namespace root, used with startsWith. It resolves the day S-E06-4 ships the /legal/* pages; until then it is dead for the same reason they are. Blocked on decision D-08.
